buyers_see: A renovated 1930s Queenslander on a full 607sqm block: the home most Camp Hill buyers are looking for.
Four bedrooms on two levels, with room to add a third bathroom.
No pool, so the yard stays open and the price stays under the pool premium.
Character streetscape protected by Brisbane's pre-1947 character rules.
Close to Martha Street cafes and the Camp Hill shopping village.

price.why_heading: Why the guide sits where it does
price.why:
Camp Hill buyers are active, with 4-bed prices up 22% in a year, but all six competing homes have been listed longer than the 26-day median. A guide of offers over $1.85m matches the closest competing home and puts yours in front of every buyer searching from $1.8m.

Your reserve and sale method are your call. We'll talk both through with you.
